issue.title: Error message if no manual control is available

labels.name: beginner
labels.description: A good issue for someone that only gets started

issue.body:
It would be nice to have an error message if starting altitude or position control using manual_control fails.

This would be similar as it is done for offboard: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/758a6437826aa1e6a1abda5f109a7bca21599d61/src/plugins/offboard/offboard_impl.cpp#L43

comments.body:
Hi!
I think I can get on with implementing this.

Just to clarify. This error message reporting will go in the Manual Control plugin and is used if some means of control i.e. a joystick is not available?

From what I am understanding (and can confirm by testing), manual control needs a setpoint before entering the mode. This is an example for offboard `offboard->set_velocity_body({0, 0, 0, 0}); `
So, in code it looks like this:
`auto offboard = std::make_shared<Offboard>(*system);`
` offboard->set_velocity_body({0, 0, 0, 0}); /* Needed */`
`Offboard::Result offboard_result = offboard->start();`

Without the `offboard->set_velocity_body({0, 0, 0, 0}); ` then we get the Result shown in Julian's comment above (Offboard::Result::NoSetpointSet;). 

**Manual Control**
Manual Control needs to be started in a very similar fashion

`manual_control->set_manual_control_input(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f); /*Needed*/`
 `auto manual_control_result = manual_control->start_position_control();`

However, if the `manual_control->set_manual_control_input(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);` is NOT there, manual control will not be achieved. This should be an error. However, the code returns ManualControl::Result::Success instead of a result that would indicate that manual control is not going to work. (For example: ManualControl::Result::NoSetpointSet)

**TODO**
Implement something like ManualControl::Result::NoSetpointSet that will tell the developer they need to insert `manual_control->set_manual_control_input(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f); ` into their code

@julianoes is that a fair analysis?

Sorry for the late response here.

> Just to clarify. This error message reporting will go in the Manual Control plugin and is used if some means of control i.e. a joystick is not available?

Yes.

> @julianoes is that a fair analysis?

100%, thanks for writing that up @afwilkin.

issue.title: No setpoint manual control

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
For #1173

Essentially just implements the same thing that offboard does with `Mode::NotActive` for this by adding` enum class Input { NotSet, Set } _input = Input::NotSet`. 
One thing that I am not sure about is that offboard has a `stop_sending_setpoints()` method to reset the `_mode` to `Mode::NotActive` after it has been set by some other method. I dont know if this is also needed for manual control. If it is need I will need some insights to implement it.

Tested this by calling the `start_position_control()` without setting any setpoints first with `set_manual_control_input()` with the following result 

```
[01:45:25|Info ] MAVSDK version: v0.34.0-6-g5c2031d9 (mavsdk_impl.cpp:20)
Waiting to discover system...
[01:45:25|Info ] New system on: 127.0.0.1:14580 (with sysid: 1) (udp_connection.cpp:190)
[01:45:25|Debug] New: System ID: 1 Comp ID: 1 (mavsdk_impl.cpp:417)
[01:45:25|Debug] Component Autopilot (1) added. (system_impl.cpp:314)
[01:45:25|Debug] Discovered 1 component(s) (UUID: 5283920058631409231) (system_impl.cpp:471)
Discovered system
Waiting for system to be ready
System is ready
Position control start failed: Unknown
```

I dont know if this is how @julianoes wanted it to be done so if its not the solution that is desired I can try to do what is required after discussing.

issue.title: manual_control: use proper result if input not set

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
A result/error of unknown is not a good user feedback. Instead we need
to communicate the actual reason.

Closes #1173.
